verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly pixel-identical 320x50 banners, so neither is the better resize. Both wrap the headline onto two lines, leaving 'fizz' as an orphan. Both shrink the SOLSTICE can to a tiny, unrecognisable icon jammed under the logo. Both cram the legal line into an illegible block of a few pixels under the CTA. The background circles are reduced to clipped fragments. The CTA is readable and the left-to-right order holds, but the headline wrap and the unreadable legal text are shipping blockers in both.
